Can I reroute the package to a different address?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
It depends on whether the order has already shipped.
Before shipping:
You can change the shipping address within 2 hours of placing the order from your account page. Address changes must stay within the same state due to tax rules. 
After the order has shipped:
The delivery address cannot be changed on our side. However, some couriers allow delivery customization through their tracking page, such as:
• Holding the package for pickup
• Redirecting to a pickup location
• Rescheduling delivery
• Updating the address (sometimes with a fee)
You can check these options directly on the courier’s tracking page using the tracking link from your shipping email.

turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
ensation policy for shipping delays.
The usual approach is to focus on getting the shipment delivered first. After the delivery situation is resolved, possible ways to make up for the wait may be discussed.
Separately, if an order is not delivered within two months from the order date, a full refund may be issued (this does not apply to preorders or unique releases).
